title: RoseGoldItemsAndOverhaul
description: My very first mod, adding Rose gold items into the game and some new recipes and trades for a better survival experience.
body:
Adding Rose Gold items to bridge iron to diamond gear, and a infused variant for a netherite upgrade.

Added Crafting recipes to:
-saddle
-enchanted golden apple
-blaze powder from a new item called "blaze powder essence" obtained from blasting a magma cream
-elytra

New Items:
Rose Gold Gear and Tools
-> Infused variant

a shrink and growth apple to make your player small or normal sized
-> growth apple only returns you to the normal player size, made for reverting effects of shrink apple
-> shrink apple makes you smaller, when you crouch you can fit into 1 block in height. less health, faster attacking, movespeed and less fall damage.

New Villager trades for:
-spider eyes
-prismarine shards and crystals
-growth and shrink apple
